# StreamDek Mobile v2.0.6

## What's New

- Added a focused Live TV long-press menu with Add to Favourites, Watch on StreamDek TV, and Share.
- Added end-to-end Live TV handoff to connected StreamDek TVs, including automatic source resolution before transfer.
- Restored the 4K hero-trailer quality option and 2160p trailer resolution support.

## Improvements

- Live TV handoff now refreshes the linked-TV list and reports clear, human-readable status messages.
- Trailer quality preferences now retain 4K consistently across local storage and cloud preference sync.
- Added regression coverage for 4K trailer resolution limits and secure handoff compatibility.

## Fixes

- Fixed secure handoff compatibility with Android TV and Fire TV RSA-OAEP implementations.
- Fixed Live TV cards opening unrelated media actions on long press.
- Fixed 2160p trailer requests being silently limited to 1080p.
